cover_letter:
Dear 24Flow team,

I'm excited to apply for the Medior Digital Marketeer position. Your mission to increase qualified inbound leads through hands-on ownership of digital channels resonates with my experience and approach.

At Episto, I own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and write keyword-targeted blog content to grow organic traffic. I build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, and track performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads to guide decisions. This hands-on experience has taught me to spot underperforming areas and act quickly.

On my own project, mirook.com, I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site and implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema), entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. I ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score. This project reflects my passion for experimenting with new tools and staying ahead of search trends, including GEO and AEO.

I'm drawn to 24Flow's scale-up environment and the opportunity to work with a Salesforce-based platform. While I haven't used marketing automation tools like HubSpot or Pardot yet, I'm a quick learner and have a strong technical foundation that helps me pick up new platforms fast. I'm eager to apply my SEO, content, and web skills to your inbound lead generation, and to grow into marketing automation and AppExchange optimization.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and work in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level and improving. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
